source.code:
/-- `f.IsBounded r`: the filter `f` is eventually bounded w.r.t. the relation `r`,
i.e. eventually, it is bounded by some uniform bound.
`r` will be usually instantiated with `(· ≤ ·)` or `(· ≥ ·)`. -/
def IsBounded (r : α → α → Prop) (f : Filter α) :=
  ∃ b, ∀ᶠ x in f, r x b
